reason: Adds five selectable color themes to the DeepSeek Web UI through a Settings panel row, CSS token overrides, and browser-local preference persistence.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Web UI 的设置面板中提供五种可选配色主题，并在浏览器中应用和保存用户选择。
summaries.en: Adds five selectable color themes to the DeepSeek Web UI and applies and persists the user’s choice in the browser.

capabilities: Adds a color-theme selector to the web UI Settings panel
Applies CSS custom-property theme overrides in the browser
Persists the selected theme in browser localStorage
Synchronizes theme changes across open tabs via the storage event
